steps.name: Siege
steps.text: They're still on our tails.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: You should go... someone of your station shouldn't risk her life for us...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Would you say the same if it was Allerdale or Clovisia?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: ...You're different.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Heads down.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Huh?
Siege's hammer swings through the air, barely missing the fighter's head.
A massive hole appears on the wall with the sound of bricks cracking. Within lies the severed hand of a Sarkaz caster, still holding his wand.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Different, am I?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: You... you...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Stay close. I'm not in the habit of slowing down my fights.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We haven't shaken them yet.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: These Sarkaz are persistent.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Their uniform is the same, but the Sarkaz of Sudean are like children compared to these.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: They're different.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: What should we do? Keep making circles in the streets?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You used to sit in front of a desk, didn't you?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Huh? Yes, I was an accountant... why?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: How did you travel? By car?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Er, yes...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Do you know how wide a Londinium alley is? How long it takes to run from one end of Wellington to the other? How many sewer entrances there are on each block?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: They do.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Who does?

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Over here, Vina!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Target sighted!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Hostiles in the shadows!

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: This way, Vina!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I hear explosions coming from the safehouse.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: The Corps fighters aren't moving quick enough. We have to cover their retreat.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Grr. This way!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Siege!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dagda, what's the situation?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Clovisia evacuated with most of them. Allerdale...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: ...I'm fine.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You're hurt.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I can take care of myself.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You should not have returned, Your Highness.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: They're inside.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Kill them all.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Forgive my bluntness, Siege, I don't think you should...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You don't think I should have come back either?

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: No, I don't think you should be at front, by yourself.

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Allow me to stand by your side, from time to time.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Very well. Come forward, Dagda.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You need to rest, Allerdale.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The daughter of the Duke of Cumberland can't lose to the daughter of the Count of Manchester.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I know Allerdale and Dagda better.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Then I'll stand by your side, as your friend, Allerdale.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: What about you, soldier? Can you stand?

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Y-Yes...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Then grab your weapon and fight.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Londinium... this iron jungle belongs to us. It's time to show the Sarkaz who is hunter and who is hunted.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Your station won't save you, Aslan.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: We don't care.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The Sarkaz future is now. You'll be buried with the past.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Wait...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Look out! Ambush, behind the shelves!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You're sharp.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Hey! Over here!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: No, here!

steps.name: Dagda
steps.text: Do it, Siege!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Now then.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Look out!

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Flashy, but pointless.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Playtime's over. Drop your weapon and you can die a quick death.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Make things easier for both of us.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Sorry... I got careless.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: No need to apologize.
The Sarkaz gazes at Siege, and Siege gazes at Allerdale.
She raises her hands slowly. Her hammer falls to the ground with a bang.
She winks at Allerdale, who raises the corner of her mouth.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Wait... wind? But we're indoors...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: It's...

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Damn it, it's Arts! Incoming!

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Vina, catch!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Now then.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: Gah—!

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I'm in a good mood, at least.

steps.name: Sarkaz Warrior
steps.text: The warehouse is collapsing! Pull out! Surround them outside!

steps.name: Indra
steps.text: Your safehouse doesn't seem so solid.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Safehouses aren't meant to be impregnable fortresses.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Follow me.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The hidden passage should be blocked under the rubble, but we need to up our pace.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You need to get your wounds wrapped, Allerdale.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I... I'm fine.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Dagda, take the fighter back to the Self-Salvation Corps camp. We'll split up.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Your Hig—Siege.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: You showed your leadership. Now it's our turn to show you what we can do.

steps.name: Self-Salvation Corps Fighter
steps.text: Thank you.

steps.name: Morgan
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Allerdale's injuries can't wait. I'll find somewhere nearby...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Wait, I remember this place...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Surprised you still have an impression of this alley, Vina.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: That afternoon, when you brought back the Sighs of Kings, with them.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...What?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Nothing. Let's keep going.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: This path connects the palace to the ducal residence. Not many know of its existence.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I have assurances from one whose word carries weight that Cumberland Manor will be safe until tomorrow.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Enough for us to get these little flesh wounds treated.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Vina...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You knew I was there?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I know what sounds I should hear from outside my room.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: My dear Lady Vina, staring at me won't heal the wounds on my back.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Would you kindly change the bandages?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...Right.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Sorry, was I too heavy-handed?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It's nothing. I just let my guard down when there aren't so many eyes on me.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: You bled a lot... how many times did you get hit?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Most of them don't hurt anymore.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: If I reacted faster... maybe it would have saved you a scar.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Escaping from those fighters was no mean feat.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Besides, I've been wanting to thank you for days.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You've helped the Corps a lot, and you even saved the old steam armor.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I have a responsibility, Allerdale. I... I don't want to see you lose anything else.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Hah.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: No matter, Vina. If there's one thing I've learned over the years, it's that life usually doesn't go the way we want.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: If it did, we wouldn't be hiding in this dark, little room, and we wouldn't be sitting with a bunch of stinking bandages.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: We...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Let me think... we'd be sitting in a garden, taking tea together, discussing poetry and the weather.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We could go hunting. The alcornes are plentiful in the countryside this season. They run fast, but stop and stare when they see a crowd. Do you like hunting?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...I don't know.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I've almost forgotten how it feels myself. But I'm guessing you don't like dancing, at least not at those onerous dance parties in the social season. I don't like them either.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The dresses are so much stiffer than hunting attire, and so tight they rob you of your appetite for the banquet.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Ha, I can imagine.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: And...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: I'm thinking the hunting outfit would look better on you.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Vina...

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Yes?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Perhaps... we should have seen more of each other. Much more.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Fate robbed us of a beautiful life, against our will.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Luckily, we still have the future...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: What's the matter? You look surprised.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: ...I'm talking about the future.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: You don't do that often?

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Back when I was running for my life, I hardly ever thought about the future. The past was in my dreams, and the future... it was in a fog, where I couldn't see anything.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: This is not a flaw, Vina. It's a virtue.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Nobles like to talk about the future, but most of them are more concerned about the dinner menu.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It's not because they've grown numb to life, but because they understand how precious the present is.

steps.name: Siege
steps.text: Like the present now?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Yes...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Like the present now.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Ailshie.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Good morning, Lady Allerdale. Everything is in order.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The steam armor... why have you taken it out?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It's too big to take with us.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: ...Is that so?

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Has Her Highness Alexandrina left?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Yes, she has her own mission.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Your injuries...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Are fine, thanks to Her Highness.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: I haven't seen you smile like this in a long time.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Am I being too calm before the storm?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It does bring back long-forgotten feelings to stand with Her Highness and the others.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: It's been some time since I encountered someone I could trust.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Her Highness Alexandrina saved this armor for you. I may be a lowly servant, but I feel a sense of gratitude.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: It's the pride of Cumberland.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Pride...

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: The armor and your honored ancestors... I remember how you used to talk to them.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Children like to wallow in fantasy.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: But I learned, twenty-six years ago, that it's no hero, just a broken hunk of metal.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: We've all changed, yet the armor seems frozen in time.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Do you... like Her Highness Alexandrina?

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Her Highness is very kind. I've seen how she treats her fellows, eating the same food and sleeping in the same room.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: She's not like most nobles. She doesn't see them as her servants, nor will she abandon them.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Victoria is fortunate.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The heart of Her Highness is strong. Years of exile have not undermined her dignity and integrity.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: You said Victoria. What about yourself, my lady? What do you think of Her Highness?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I hope she has a bright future.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: So you...?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I got a letter last night. Two in the same day.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: She's... impatient.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: But you've reunited with Her Highness!

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Do you remember how Her Highness came here with the Sighs of Kings, twenty-six years ago? It must've been a sign, and its portents might come true very soon!

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: We've waited for so long, Miss. You could...

a.text: You will meet Vina again, someday.'

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: He...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I've long since given up waiting, Ailshie.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: How long has it been since Jim left?

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: He returned home to County Peninsula the year after the incident.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: ...Twenty-five years. We haven't had a gardener for a quarter century.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I used to love the bushes that grew there. They tripped me from time to time, but the tiny golden flowers that bloomed from them were so beautiful.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: The first batch all died the winter after Jim left.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Mother sent people all around and learned that it was the noblest breed from Minos. The money it took to buy those seeds would have fed an ordinary family of Londiniers for half a decade.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Your garden remains beautiful, even without that particular kind of bush.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I tried, Ailshie. We all tried. You toiled tirelessly, summer and winter, in order to keep the garden in good shape.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: But without those seeds, our garden would never return to its former glory.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I sent her a letter the fifth New Year's Day after Dad died.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Her reply included the seeds that House Cumberland could no longer afford.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Ailshie... we've always been living like this.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: If the Duke was here...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: ...She always had tricks up her sleeve.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: No, my lady, I meant your father.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Father... father.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I can hardly recall his voice now.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Perhaps it's only in this garden that I... that I remember how he held my hand, taught my how to swing a sword, knocked me down, then picked me back up and sat me on his shoulder...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I wanted to preserve them, many years ago, Ailshie. I tried everything I could. The garden, the armor... and the shadow of my father.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: But there is nothing worth less than 'want'.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I remember how I wanted to become a Steam Knight when I was little.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Ailshie. Sometimes... just sometimes, I think...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Growing up is such a cruel thing, isn't it?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: With the exception of a lucky few, we all become tired and unremarkable adults.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Always treading carefully, not daring to speak our minds, grasping at straws when the waves are rough, and never letting go of the ones we find.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: What did you want to be when you were little, Ailshie? Not the servant of a fallen house, surely?

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: No, it's an honor to be by your side...

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I want the truth.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Well... I suppose... I listened to a lot of bard's tales when I was little.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Ah. Ailshie the Bard.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Please don't tease me.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Growing up means toppling, crushing, turning to dust the possibilities that we thought were within our reach when we were little.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: And here we are.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Can I preserve House Cumberland's glory? It passed beyond my reach a long time ago.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I, Allerdale, am who I am now.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: ...But even you cannot say who Allerdale will be, can you?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Will be...?

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: I'm old, Miss. I couldn't squeeze a tune out of an instrument, even if I had the chance.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: But you promised me.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Maybe you thought it was just a childish fancy.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: But I've always believed that you could do it.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: To be a Steam Knight greater than Charles Lynch, greater than any of your ancestors.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: You'll do it for me, won't you?

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Enough, Ailshie! She wouldn't permit...

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Then what do you want to do?

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: I'm behind you, no matter your choice.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: I—

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Take your time. You always make the right decision.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: Miss... permit me walk around this garden, one last time.

steps.name: Ailshie
steps.text: It's most dear to me... even if it's just a shadow of its former self.
Allerdale wants to say something, but does not open her mouth.

She watches someone, with whom she has spent virtually every day of her entire life, walk towards the center of the garden. They have been through the worst of times together, and have been transformed them in ways they could not have imagined.
Allerdale realizes that she has not seen Ailshie smile like this for years.
She feels a sense of tranquility, one that she has not felt in ages.
If there is still a chance—
Suddenly, Allerdale's attention is drawn to a speck of orange in the distance.
It rapidly draws near, and she feels the temperature around her rise.

steps.name: Allerdale
steps.text: Ailshie! Quick, we must—
In an instant, the manor is engulfed in flames.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: ...Your Highness.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Quiet.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: You're disturbing my enjoyment of the view.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Storied history turns to cinder. The proud manors of the nobles, reduced to charred ruins.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Tiles carefully sculpted and laid over centuries peel off one by one. Flowers collected from all the corners of the land wilt and wither.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: My orders were to investigate the nobles.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Are you not happy with what I'm doing, 'Commander'?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: Do you not enjoy the flames? Does the sound of blood evaporating not interest you?

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: 'Hiss, hiss.' Listen and savor, Lettou, my friend.

steps.name: Sanguinarch of Vampires
steps.text: I'm examining every drop of blood, as is my responsibility...

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: I will assist your investigation, ensuring that no... traitor... walks free.

steps.name: Lt. Colonel Lettou
steps.text: As is my duty.
